description: This file defines the SystemNotification entity class used within the sales management system. It models notifications related to the system, including fields for IDs, keys, values, associated merchant store and user, start and end dates, and audit information. It integrates JPA annotations for ORM mapping and implements auditing features.

classes.name: SystemNotification
classes.description: Entity class representing system notifications, with fields for notification key, value, associated merchant and user, start/end dates, and audit info. Annotated for JPA persistence.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the notification entity

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the notification entity

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration key for the notification

methods.name: setKey
methods.description: Sets the configuration key for the notification

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Gets the start date of the notification's validity period

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the notification

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Gets the end date of the notification's validity period

methods.name: setEndDate

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the associated merchant store, if any

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this notification

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the user associated with the notification, if any

methods.name: setUser
